headline: PHP ships security update fixing critical remote-code-execution flaw
summary: PHP's development team issued a security release addressing a critical remote-code-execution vulnerability. One outlet reported the update fixes 18 flaws in total, including bugs that could let unauthenticated attackers run code on vulnerable servers; coverage filed before the release described the same dangerous RCE bug as awaiting a fix.
